items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: You know, like Jon Hendricks things.

ctx.x: I’ll have to check it out. I didn’t even know he did that kind of music. We’re mostly familiar with a couple of his hits.
Yeah but he did a lot of jazz, and a lot of vocalese. You know, like Jon Hendricks things.
Oh, Jon Hendricks, one of my favorites.
